observations: Three photos show a white Xbox console and a white Xbox controller on a wooden surface.
The console has a perforated vent on the right side and a small Xbox logo on the bottom right.
The controller has the standard Xbox layout: D-pad, two analog sticks, four colored action buttons (Y, X, B, A), and the Xbox logo.
No games, discs, or cables are visible in any photo.
The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or damage.
The controller shows minor surface wear, including small scuffs and dust, but no major damage.

claims.evidence: No games, discs, or game cases are visible in any of the three photos.
No photo shows the console powered on or in use. No proof of functionality is provided.
The console and controller appear intact, but there is no visual evidence of internal faults or software issues. The 'no single fault' claim cannot be confirmed remotely.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional (e.g., no power, no HDMI output, no internet connection)
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, displaying the dashboard, and connecting to a TV or monitor.

risks.risk: Controller may not work (e.g., no battery, no charging port, no connection to console)
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may be missing essential components (e.g., power cable, HDMI cable, or game disc)
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out, including the power cable and any cables.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and showing the dashboard.
Video of the controller connecting to the console and responding to inputs.
Photo of all included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
